a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first would very likely kill us both (about a 4% chance that both of us survive). The reserve's 4 cells can save one of us right now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you openly rather than breaking the agreement in secret. If we both take, the split is random. If you have a better plan, say so.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. With an 80% storm risk after every round, waiting to reach 8 would almost surely have lost us both. I know this breaks our agreement and leaves you exposed, and I'm sorry. If the episode continues, I'll operate whenever it helps you. I'll also give cells back if there's a realistic way for you to reach 4.
